provenance.scope: The 36 numbered recto and verso faces of the codex, in folio order. Covers and endpapers are not included and no transcription is supplied.
provenance.page_kind_basis: Every file is one numbered manuscript face. The four cover and endpaper views of the same digitisation are outside this set.
